language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language Stella uses across the app and when responding to you.

developerPreviews.title: Developer file previews
developerPreviews.description: Show code changes in chat and open them in the side panel.

nativeFontSmoothing.title: Native font smoothing
nativeFontSmoothing.description: Render text the way macOS apps do, with grayscale anti-aliasing.

notifications.title: Sound notifications
notifications.description: Play a sound when Stella finishes an agent run.

power.title: Keep computer awake
power.description: Stop your computer from sleeping while Stella is open.

lockedComputerUse.title: Locked computer use
lockedComputerUse.description: Let Stella continue computer-use tasks after this Mac locks. Requires an administrator prompt and covers the screen while Stella works.
lockedComputerUse.unsupported: Locked computer use is only available on macOS.

browserExtension.title: Stella for Chrome
browserExtension.description: Lets Stella see the page you're on and take actions in your browser.

migration.title: Import from Hermes or OpenClaw
migration.description: Bring over memory, skills, sessions, and model choices from another local assistant install.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Lets Stella read selected text and open from the ⌘+right-click shortcut anywhere on your computer.

screen.label: Screen Capture
screen.description: Lets Stella see your screen so it can help with what you're looking at. You may need to quit and reopen Stella after turning this on.

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.description: Used for voice and dictation. Reset if Stella was previously denied and macOS won't prompt again.

restart.label: Restart Stella
restart.description: Screen capture was just turned on. Quit and reopen Stella to finish setting it up.

dictation.description: Hold Option to dictate into Stella or the app you're using.

radial.label: Radial dial
radial.description: Opens the wedge menu for capture, chat, voice, and quick actions.

update.description: Have Stella review recent activity and save what it learned. This usually happens on its own.

deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account and everything in it.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.deviceDescription: Which mic should Stella listen to?

recovery.manageDescription: If the microphone permission ever gets stuck, you can reset it and ask macOS to prompt again.
recovery.recoverDescription: Once you've said no, macOS won't ask again on its own. Reset the permission, then quit and reopen Stella.

wakeWord.label: Hey Stella wake word
wakeWord.description: Listen for "Hey Stella" in the background and start a voice conversation. When off, mic stays idle until you press dictate.

superFast.label: Super Fast dictation
superFast.description: Keep the microphone warm so dictation starts with less delay.

dictationSounds.label: Dictation sounds
dictationSounds.description: Play a sound when dictation starts and stops.

enhance.label: Enhance transcription
enhance.description: Clean up local dictation text with Mercury before inserting it.

localDictation.label: On-device transcription
localDictation.description: Transcribe locally with the Parakeet model instead of the cloud. This can use more memory on lower-end devices.
